content:
The age of the universe is approximately **13.8 billion years**.

This estimate is based on precise measurements from observations of the **cosmic microwave background radiation** (CMB), particularly data from space missions like the **Planck satellite**. The age is derived from the **Lambda-CDM model**, the standard model of Big Bang cosmology, which incorporates the expansion rate of the universe (the Hubble constant) and the densities of matter, dark energy, and radiation.

Scientists continue to refine this number, but it is generally agreed upon to be **13.787 ± 0.020 billion years**, based on the most recent and accurate data.
